logline: 형에게 쫓겨난 아우가 다친 제비를 고쳐 주고, 그 제비가 박씨 하나를 물어다 준다.
destination: 초가 지붕 위에 열린 커다란 박 — 톱질 끝에 무엇이 나올지
protagonist: 누더기 무명옷에 상투를 튼 마흔 살 가난한 사내
setting: 조선 시대의 가난한 초가와 형의 기와집
anchor: a poor Korean man of forty, topknot, patched undyed hemp jacket and trousers, bare feet
palette: straw gold, hanji cream, blue-black, autumn ochre

rich_brother.label: 놀부
rich_brother.desc: a fat scowling Korean man in his forties, oiled topknot, glossy dark silk vest over a fine jacket, thick belt

poor_family.label: 흥부네 아이들
poor_family.desc: a cluster of thin Korean children in ragged hemp clothes, bare feet, tangled hair

heungbu_man.label: 흥부
heungbu_man.desc: a thin Korean man of forty, worn topknot, patched undyed hemp jacket and rolled trousers, bare feet

beats.visual: a fat man in fine silk barring a tiled-roof gate against a thin ragged man on the road outside
beats.motion: the gate is shoved closed toward the road, the thin man staggers back, dust lifts

beats.beat: 아우가 다 쓰러져 가는 초가에 짐을 푼다.
beats.visual: a ragged man and thin children before a collapsing thatched hut in a bare field
beats.motion: straw slides off the roof, the children crowd toward him, wind flattens the grass

beats.beat: 아우가 처마에서 떨어진 제비를 두 손에 받는다.
beats.visual: a ragged man cupping a small injured swallow in both hands beneath a thatched eave
beats.motion: the swallow flutters in his palms, straw dust drifts down, his sleeves shake

beats.beat: 아우가 제비 다리를 헝겊으로 감아 준다.
beats.visual: a man winding a strip of cloth around a swallow's leg, seated on a worn wooden step
beats.motion: the cloth wraps around the tiny leg, the bird's wings twitch, light shifts

beats.beat: 이듬해 봄 제비가 씨앗 하나를 떨어뜨린다.
beats.visual: a swallow in flight releasing a single seed above a thatched roof, spring sky
beats.motion: the seed drops down toward the roof, the swallow banks away, clouds slide

beats.beat: 지붕 위에 커다란 박이 여럿 열린다.
beats.visual: enormous pale gourds swelling across a thatched roof, a ragged family staring up
beats.motion: the gourds sway on their vines, the family tips their heads back, leaves rustle

beats.beat: 온 식구가 톱을 잡고 박을 켜기 시작한다.
beats.visual: a ragged family drawing a long two-handled saw across a giant gourd in a yard
beats.motion: the saw drags back and forth across the gourd, dust falls, the family leans in

beats.beat: 마당에 톱과 반쯤 켠 박만 남는다.
beats.visual: an abandoned two-handled saw resting in a half-cut giant gourd, empty yard at dusk
beats.motion: the saw settles into the cut, gourd dust drifts, evening light fades on the yard

withheld: 박에서 쏟아진 보물과, 이를 흉내 낸 형이 맞는 결말
